preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
All characters in the input string s must be lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of the omeric string followed by the frequencies of each prefix on a new line.
The length of the omeric string must be equal to the length of the input string s.
Each frequency in the prefix frequencies must be at least 1.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= len(s) <= 10**5","description":"The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"all(c.islower() for c in s)","description":"All characters in the input string s must be lowercase letters."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == omeric_string + '\\n' + ' '.join(map(str, prefix_frequencies))","description":"The output must consist of the omeric string followed by the frequencies of each prefix on a new line."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"len(omerics_string) == len(s)","description":"The length of the omeric string must be equal to the length of the input string s."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"all(f >= 1 for f in prefix_frequencies)","description":"Each frequency in the prefix frequencies must be at least 1."}],"invariants":[]}
